sprint: Move and Spin become ONE widget. The product owner's own words, with a mockup: "we can combine spin and move panel into one. something like this." — a single circle where the 8 direction arrows ring a Spin disc, and the reset knob sits on the disc's own hub.
task: Two rows become one. js/contextPanel.js's _makeNudgePadRow and _makeRotationDial are replaced by _makeSpatialWidget, which assembles _makeNudgePad (the ring, 8 arrows, no hub), _makeDial (the disc alone, no row/label of its own) and _makeCenterButton (the hub) into one row with one shared label and a two-line legend. The disc nests INSIDE the ring; the hub sits ON the disc, its pointerdown stopping propagation so tapping reset never also starts a rotate drag. Geometry moved from fixed pixels to percentages of the pad with a translate(-50%,-50%) on every absolutely-placed child, because the Selection Action Strip sizes itself to whatever gutter room it finds (MIN_USABLE 160px) and a fixed ~150px widget could otherwise overflow the narrowest popup; the ring caps at 150px and everything scales with it. Buttons went 30px -> 28px so the disc has room, and the disc derives its own 52% from that same ring geometry (DIAL_PCT_OF_PAD), with the CSS width kept in step and commented as such. .nudge-btn:active restates the centring translate before scale(0.88) — a bare scale() would have snapped every pressed button up and left. The ring gets a faint warm wash and the disc a gold rim so the two zones read apart. A moveable-but-not-rotatable object (a full-bleed colour fill has no orientation; a non-rotatable Place is guardrailed off) gets the ring with the hub in its own centre and no disc rendered at all — Guardrails unchanged. Verified 27/27 via a new combined_widget_verify suite: one spatial row, the disc genuinely nested and centred within 1px, all 8 arrows at the same radius with none overlapping the disc, the hub resetting position without spinning, a real click moving right and only right, a real drag at 6 o'clock spinning to ~180 with the shared readout following, the widget fitting inside the popup, and the ring-only shape for the non-rotating case. Regression: spatial_controls 40/40 (two assertions updated for the intended 28px button and the readout now living on the shared row label), four_bugs 36/36 (two updated for the merged "Move & Spin" label), voice_place 16/16, fa_replace_everywhere 22/22, voice_note 22/22, fromworld_tile 13/13, photo_via_studio 8/8, bg_default 12/12, both goldenBuilds PASS.
